judgment_scale: binary: a paper is relevant if its title or abstract directly addresses the question
notes: relevant lists are PubMed IDs from corpus.xml. Empty lists on answerable questions mean NOT YET JUDGED, not 'nothing relevant'.
Unanswerable questions have no relevant papers by construction: the corpus does not cover them.
Judgments were made by reading titles and abstracts of the pooled candidates, see docs/EVALUATION.md.
